subject: Florashare renewal: prorated invoice routing + payor handover
messages:
From: Ivy Chen <ivy@florashare.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Dale <marcus.dale@florashare.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal billing — shifting payor to parent entity, prorated Q3 invoice

Hi Neha,

Quick note as we finalize the renewal: our parent entity (Florashare Holdings) will take over payment for Redwood starting 2026-08-15. That means the upcoming renewal invoice needs to be split — a prorated amount for the remainder of Jul–Sep goes to Florashare (current legal entity), and starting 8/15 forward the monthly invoices should be issued to Florashare Holdings with the new PO.

Can you confirm the process on your side for: 1) accepting a new PO from Florashare Holdings (we expect to send PO #98821), 2) issuing a prorated invoice for Aug 1–Aug 14 to our current entity, and 3) updating the billing contact and tax docs on file (we will provide updated W-9 from Holdings)?

We also need a short timeline so we can get approvals from our procurement team — target go-live for billing handover is 2026-08-15.

Thanks,
Ivy Chen
Finance Operations
Florashare

[attachment: Florashare_PO_98821.pdf (application/pdf)]

Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal billing — shifting payor to parent entity, prorated Q3 invoice

Ivy — thanks for the heads up and the PO.

High level we can support the split and payor handover. Proposed next steps (we can do this same day once docs arrive):
- We will accept PO #98821 once we receive it from Florashare Holdings (please send to billing@redwood.com and cc me).
- Redwood can generate a prorated invoice for 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-14 billed to Florashare (current entity).
- Starting 2026-08-15, monthly invoices will be routed to Florashare Holdings (new payor) using the billing contact on the submitted W-9.

Questions for your team:
1) Will Holdings provide a separate billing contact and AP email for automated invoice ingestion?
2) Do you require us to apply the same committed capacity pricing to Holdings or will this be considered a new contract line item (I can loop in sales ops if there's any pricing tweak).

I'll coordinate with Finance Ops (cc'd Marissa) to prepare the prorated invoice and with Accounts (cc'd Vivek) for the payor switch. If you can push the W-9 and the PO to billing@redwood.com today, we should be able to make the 8/15 switch.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Adding details from AR side — action items for processing:
- Once PO 98821 arrives we will validate entity name and remit-to details. Expected capture fields: legal name, remit address, EIN, AP contact email.
- For the prorated invoice we will create two line items: (a) prorated charge for 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-14 billed to Florashare (entity A) and (b) commitment adjustment starting 2026-08-15 billed to Florashare Holdings (entity B).
- We will mark the first invoice as "prorated split" in our system and include a reference to both PO numbers (if Holdings has a separate PO for the remainder period).

Notes / requirements for Ivy (please confirm):
- PDF of Holdings W-9 with EIN and signature (for our vendor file)
- AP email to route electronic invoices (we support both AP@ and invoice@ patterns; ACH/EFT setup forms if you prefer direct debit)
- If Holdings wants to preserve committed pricing, we need an email from your Sales contact confirming pricing applies to Holdings (or an amendment).

I will prepare the draft prorated invoice and upload the XLS summarizing the split to the Drive folder linked below; sending to Ivy once they confirm the W-9.

Marissa Cole
